title: Kīlauea Episode 46 eruption window opens May 4-7 — USGS HVO advisory
snippet: The forecast window for episode 46 suggests lava fountaining will occur again sometime between Monday May 4 and Thursday May 7. Rapid return of inflationary tilt, strong glow from both Halemaʻumaʻu eruptive vents, heavy gas emissions and occasional flames observed overnight.
